toplevel.title: General Settings
toplevel.custom_router_path_placeholder: Enter absolute path to custom router script file
toplevel.router_section_help: Switch which selector routes Claude Code (/v1/messages) traffic. Changes take effect on the next request. OpenAI-compat callers (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses) send their exact model verbatim regardless of this mode.
toplevel.router_mode_help: scenario = classic routing map (Router.default etc.). preference = gate-only preference chain. quota-aware = scheduler-weighted preference chain with pace-aware tier shifting.
toplevel.router_shadow_help: Run a second selector alongside the primary and log its would-be decision without affecting routing. Useful for validating a new mode before flipping.
toplevel.router_rollout_pct_help: Percentage of sessions the non-scenario mode applies to; the rest stay on the scenario router. Sessions are hash-bucketed so the same session always lands in the same bucket.
toplevel.cross_provider_fallback_help: After each fallback chain entry, auto-inject peer entries with the same model name on OpenAI-family providers (openai_chat / openai_responses). A 429 on codex,gpt-5.6-luna will hop to openai,gpt-5.6-luna without hand-writing the chain. Peer entries also bypass the same-auth-mode gate so a subscription primary can fall over to an api_key peer.

routerPreferences.title: Router Preferences
routerPreferences.description: Ordered chain the quota-aware router walks. Top entry is tried first; live weight and remaining budget come from the scheduler snapshot.
routerPreferences.emptyScenario: No entries configured — requests will pass through to the model the client asked for.

addDialog.title: Add model to preference chain
addDialog.description: Add a model to the {{scenario}} chain. Pick a provider first, then choose one of its models.
addDialog.allAdded: All of this provider's models are already in the chain

routerPreferences.allowEscalationHelp: On: a request may match a candidate whose tier is above the requested one (e.g. an opus candidate for a sonnet request). Off: candidates above the requested tier are skipped.
routerPreferences.allowDemotionHelp: On: a request may match a candidate whose tier is below the requested one (e.g. a haiku candidate for a sonnet request). Off: candidates below the requested tier are skipped.
routerPreferences.minWeightPctHelp: Floor applied to every enabled candidate so a recovering account keeps receiving a small share of probe traffic. Set to 0 to disable the floor.
routerPreferences.exhaustedBehaviorHelp429: 429 + Retry-After: return a rate-limit response to the client with the seconds until the earliest window resets.
routerPreferences.exhaustedBehaviorHelpPassthrough: passthrough: fall back to the client's originally requested model without touching the preference chain.
routerPreferences.noSchedulerData: Live weight and budget are unavailable — the quota-aware scheduler is not running.
routerPreferences.longContextThresholdHelp: Requests whose input token count exceeds this fall into the longContext chain.
routerPreferences.longContextThresholdAutoHelp: Automatically use 70% of the default agent primary's context window as the threshold.
routerPreferences.longContextThresholdAutoUnresolved: Effective: {{value}} tokens (fallback — no context window known for the default model)

tierEditor.effortUnsupported: reasoning_effort is only accepted by OpenAI gpt-5.x / o-series models
